title: Incident Finding event (incident-record telemetry for GDPR Art. 33 breach-notification clock tracking)
summary: OCSF Incident Finding events the incident_management playbook emits and reads when it opens, classifies, and progresses a personal-data-breach incident through the GDPR Article 33 notification chain. Carries the operator-awareness timestamp at classification (start of the 72-hour clock), the case classification verdict, and the regulator-notification dispatch transition. Consumed by the breach-notification clock-margin KRI to compute in-flight margin per active case.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Findings category — Incident Finding class (uid 2005)
